name: Captain America
ability: You start knowing a good player. When you die, they become Captain America and learn another good player.
flavor: The shield was never about who carried it first.
firstNightReminder: Point to a good player: mark them SUCCESSOR.
otherNightReminder: If Captain America died, the SUCCESSOR becomes Captain America. Show them the token, then point to another good player and move the marker.

name: Iron Man
ability: Once per game, during the day, if 5 or fewer players are alive, publicly choose a player: they die, and so do you.
flavor: He ran the numbers. There was only ever one way this ended.

name: Spider-Man
ability: Each night, you learn if an evil player sits within 2 seats of you. [+0 to +2 Spider-Man]
flavor: The tingle at the back of the neck has never once been good news.
firstNightReminder: Nod if an evil player sits within 2 seats of Spider-Man, shake your head if not.
otherNightReminder: Nod if an evil player sits within 2 seats of Spider-Man, shake your head if not.

name: Thor
ability: Each day, you may publicly offer a living player your hammer. Tonight, you learn if they are good.
flavor: Everyone thinks they could lift it. Very few should try.
otherNightReminder: If Thor offered a player the hammer today, thumbs up if that player is good, thumbs down if not.

name: Black Panther
ability: Each night*, choose a dead player: you learn their character.
flavor: The ancestors have seen all this before, and they are happy to talk.
otherNightReminder: Black Panther chooses a dead player: show their character token.

name: Wiccan
ability: Once per game, at night*, choose a dead player: if they are a Townsfolk, they return to life, and you die.
flavor: Every spell has a price. This one is paid in full.
otherNightReminder: Wiccan may choose a dead player. If they are a Townsfolk, they return to life and Wiccan dies. Either way, mark Wiccan NO ABILITY.

name: Ant-Man
ability: Each night*, choose a player: you learn who they chose tonight.
flavor: You won't notice him on your shoulder. He notices everything.
otherNightReminder: Ant-Man chooses a player: point to whoever that player chose tonight. If they chose nobody, shake your head.

name: Doctor Strange
ability: You start knowing which Demon is in play, and 1 Minion that is not.
flavor: He has watched this end millions of ways. He's only telling you two things.
firstNightReminder: Show Doctor Strange the Demon token in play, then a Minion token that is not in play.

name: Captain Marvel
ability: From night 3 onwards, each night choose a player (not yourself): they cannot die tonight.
flavor: Late, as ever, with a very good excuse.
otherNightReminder: From night 3 onwards, Captain Marvel chooses a player other than themselves: mark them SHIELDED. They cannot die tonight.

name: Vision
ability: Each night, you learn a player who is not the Demon.
flavor: Patient, precise, and crossing names off a very short list.
firstNightReminder: Point to a player who is not the Demon.
otherNightReminder: Point to a player who is not the Demon.

name: Mister Fantastic
ability: Each night*, choose a player: you learn how many seats they are from the nearest evil player.
flavor: He has measured the distance, and he has also stretched to check.
otherNightReminder: Mister Fantastic chooses a player: show how many seats they are from the nearest evil player, counting the shorter way. Show 0 if they are evil.

name: The Hulk
ability: The first time you are executed, you survive, and tonight you choose a player: they die.
flavor: You really should have listened to the doctor.
otherNightReminder: If the Hulk was executed today for the first time, they choose a player: that player dies.

name: Shang-Chi
ability: Each night*, choose a player: if they are a Minion, they have no ability until dusk tomorrow.
flavor: Ten rings, and every one of them finds what it is looking for.
otherNightReminder: Shang-Chi chooses a player: if they are a Minion, mark them BOUND. They have no ability until dusk tomorrow.

name: Deadpool
ability: You cannot die. If you would, a living neighbour dies instead.
flavor: He is thrilled to be here. His neighbours have some concerns.

name: Moon Knight
ability: You do not know you are Moon Knight. You think you are a Townsfolk, but you are drunk on even-numbered nights.
flavor: Some nights it's Marc. Some nights it's Steven. Nobody told either of them.

name: Punisher
ability: On night 2, you must choose a player: they die. If they are good, you die too.
flavor: He doesn't do trials, and he doesn't do second opinions.
otherNightReminder: On night 2, the Punisher chooses a player: they die. If that player is good, the Punisher dies too.

name: Daredevil
ability: You might register as evil and as a Demon.
flavor: A man in a red devil suit, wondering why everyone keeps staring.

name: Agatha Harkness
ability: Each night, choose a player: they are poisoned until dusk tomorrow, and you learn their character.
flavor: It was her all along. It's usually her all along.
firstNightReminder: Agatha Harkness chooses a player: mark them POISONED and show their character token.
otherNightReminder: Agatha Harkness chooses a player: mark them POISONED and show their character token.

name: Ultron
ability: The first time an Ultron dies, choose a living good player: they turn evil and become Ultron.
flavor: Shut one down and there's another one already online.
otherNightReminder: If an Ultron died for the first time since last dawn, wake them: they choose a living good player, who turns evil and becomes Ultron. Show that player the token and the evil team.

name: Venom
ability: Once per game, at night*, choose a good player: they turn evil and learn you are Venom. They keep their character.
flavor: It looks like your friend. It sounds like your friend. It isn't only your friend.
otherNightReminder: Venom may choose a good player: mark them BONDED. They turn evil. Wake them, show the Venom token, point to Venom, and show them they are evil.

name: Green Goblin
ability: Once per game, at night*, choose 2 players: tomorrow they are publicly named. If neither is executed, both die at dusk.
flavor: He always asks you to choose. That's the part he enjoys.
otherNightReminder: The Green Goblin may choose 2 players: mark them TARGET. At dawn, name both. If neither is executed tomorrow, both die at dusk.

name: Thanos
ability: Each night*, choose a player: they die. Once per game, instead, half of all living players die, chosen at random. You might be one of them. [-1 Outsider]
flavor: Perfectly fair, he says, and he has never once checked the odds.
otherNightReminder: Thanos chooses a player: they die. Or, once per game, Thanos snaps: half of all living players die, rounded down, chosen at random, Thanos included.

name: Kang the Conqueror
ability: Each night*, choose a player: they die. If you would die, a living Minion dies instead. [+1 Minion]
flavor: You beat him. You also beat the other one. There are more.
otherNightReminder: Kang the Conqueror chooses a player: they die.

name: Galactus
ability: Each night*, choose a player: they die. If nobody was executed today, choose 2 players instead.
flavor: It isn't personal. It's lunch.
otherNightReminder: Galactus chooses a player: they die. If nobody was executed today, Galactus chooses 2 players.

name: Doctor Doom
ability: Each night*, choose a player: they die. On your first night, choose a good player: for the rest of the game, they register as the Demon, and you register as good. [+1 Outsider]
flavor: That was never Doom. It was a robot. The real one is standing right behind you.
firstNightReminder: Doctor Doom chooses a good player: mark them DOOMBOT. They register as the Demon, and Doctor Doom registers as good, for the rest of the game.
otherNightReminder: Doctor Doom chooses a player: they die.

name: Time Heist
ability: Once per game, during the day, the living players may vote: with a majority, one player who died last night returns to life.
flavor: One shot, one trip back, and no second chances if the plan goes wrong.
